title: Differentiation of human induced pluripotent stem cells to Purkinje neurons
protocol: Culture iPSCs on Matrigel in six-well plates in mTesR medium before differentiation.
Start the differentiation process when iPSC colonies reach 80-90% confluence.
Treat iPSCs with 1mg/ml Collagenase IV at 37°C for 15-20 min on Day 0.
Discard collagenase IV and replace with DMEM/F12 when edges of iPSC colonies peel off from the surface.
Scrape iPSC colonies into small clusters using a pipette tip.
Collect cell clusters in a 15ml centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge for 5 min at 300g on Day 0.
Resuspend cells with gfCDM medium without bFGF.
Incubate overnight to form embryonic bodies (EBs) in gfCDM medium.
Pipet the cell suspension up and down with a 5ml pipette on Day 1.
Transfer cell suspension to a 50ml centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 300g for 5 min on Day 1.
Discard supernatant and resuspend cells in gfCDM medium containing 20ng/ml bFGF on Day 1.
Change the medium to gfCDM with 20ng/ml bFGF every other day from Day 2-7.
Change the medium to gfCDM medium with 20ng/ml bFGF and 10 μg/ml cyclopamine from Day 7-10.
Transfer gfCDM EBs to a 50 ml centrifuge tube.
Pipette up and down to remove dead cells from the surface of the EB balls.
Discard the supernatant.
Suspend the EB balls with gfCDM containing 20 ng/ml bFGF without cyclopamine.
Transfer EBs to poly-D-lysin/laminin-coated 6-well plates for attachment and rosette formation.
Change medium every other day with gfCDM containing 20 ng/ml bFGF from Day 10 to Day 20.
Sterilize surgical instruments.
Disinfect preparation room by ultraviolet light.
Adjust vernier calipers on McIlwain tissue chopper to 350 μm thickness.
Modify the angle of the chopper's arm with a blade for proper horizontal slicing.
Set up speed and strength for continuous tissue cutting.
Sterilize the platform with 75% ethanol before use.
Ensure that the platform is completely dry before slicing.
Place Millicell insert into the well of a six-well plate.
Add 1 ml of slice medium onto the membrane of the insert.
Transfer the plates with inserts to a 37℃, 5% CO2 incubator.
Prepare HBSS containing 5 mg/ml D-Glucose and cool it in ice.
Deeply anesthetize the SD rat (postnatal day 10) on ice.
Clean the rat with 75% ethanol.
Remove the brain rapidly and transfer it into cold HBSS with 50 mg/ml D-glucose.
Dissect out the cerebellum and place it sagittally on the platform of a McIlwain tissue chopper.
Suck off liquid surrounding the tissue with a pipet to avoid movement during slicing.
Add some HBSS to merge chopped slices on the platform.
Carefully transfer slices into dishes containing cold HBSS supplemented with 5 mg/ml D-Glucose.
Separate slices under a dissecting microscope using micro tweezers.
Transfer separated slices carefully into the slice medium on prepared Millicell membrane inserts using a flat shovel.
Place three or four slices on one insert.
Carefully unfold slices in the medium to ensure that their surfaces touch the membrane.
Carefully transfer 1 ml of medium from the insert into the same well underneath the insert.
Treat differentiated cells with cell dissociation buffer at 37°C for 20 min.
Discard the dissociation buffer and add 2 ml DPBS into each well.
Pipette the treated cells with 1 ml tips to separate rosette-like clusters to single-cell suspension.
Transfer the cell suspension to 50 ml centrifuge tubes.
Centrifuge at 300g for 5 min.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend cells with 30 ml DPBS to wash the cells.
Reconstitute the lyophilized antibodies with Tris-buffered saline to a final concentration of 500ug/ml.
Label the secondary antibody with Lightning-Link® PE/Cy5 DIY Antibody Labeling Kit according to manufacturer procedures.
Resuspend the cell pellet with PBS containing 0.1% BSA.
Adjust the volume to get a density of 10^7 cells/ml.
Transfer 100 μl cell suspension to another two centrifuge tubes as blank and negative control, respectively.
Add Neph3 primary antibody to a final concentration of 10 μg/ml and incubate at 4°C for 30 minutes.
Wash the cells twice with DPBS.
Resuspend the cells with DPBS and adjust the DPBS volume to reach a density of 2×10^6 cells/ml.
Sort Neph3+ cells using BD FACSAria II.
Re-suspend sorted neph3+ cells in gfCDM media.
Adjust the concentration to 1×10^7 cells/ml for co-culture with slices.
Resuspend the cells with HBSS containing 5 mg/ml D-glucose and 20 ng/ml bFGF.
Adjust the cell concentration to 2×10^7 cells/ml for microinjection.
Deeply anesthetize newborn SCID/Beige mice on ice.
Inject 1 μl of cell suspension (2×10^4 cells) into the cerebellum region using a glass micropipette connected to a microinjector.
Four weeks after injection, sacrifice the mice and perfuse with 4% PFA.
Dissect the cerebellum and section at 40 μm thickness for further analysis.
